title: PCSO Lotto Results: No winners of major jackpot draws on September 21, 2026
summary: There were no winners of the major lotto jackpot draws on September 21, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Monday.

blocks.text: There were no winners of the major lotto jackpot draws on September 21, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Monday.
No bettor selected the winning combination of 54-17-51-21-37-12 for the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot prize that has reached P214,440,141.84.

According to the PCSO, the odds of winning the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot are exactly 1 in 28,989,675. This means that for every single ticket combination you buy, your chance of hitting all six numbers correctly is approximately 0.00000345%.
No one also chose the winning numbers of 36-43-07-02-28-39 for the Megalotto 6/45 jackpot prize of 67,374,234.81.
